scientific_limitations: Only literal factors and suffixes of complete finite Zimin words over distinct symbols; partial DFAs, not general morphic patterns or arbitrary prefixes. A complete DFA adds one rejecting sink. The automaton graph is new claim; generic state lower bound and existing factor-membership algorithm are prior work.
title: Explicit minimal factor and suffix automata of finite Zimin words
